name: CorpLink
summary: Melbourne/Brisbane dialup + hosting ISP (brand of APAC Internet Ltd); redirected to Lexicon Internet by 2004, absorbed into EFTel by 2006.

events.details: Retail site live through mid-2004; corplink.com.au began 301-redirecting to lexicon.net by Aug 2004 and to w3.eftel.com by Feb 2005 - absorbed into EFTel via Lexicon Internet.
